description: This file defines the class ANTLRStringStream, which implements the CharStream interface for handling character streams, including methods for consuming characters, marking positions, rewinding, seeking, and retrieving substrings. It appears to be part of a parser or lexer component, likely used in language processing or compilation.

classes.name: ANTLRStringStream
classes.description: A class implementing CharStream for managing character input streams with support for lookahead, marking, rewinding, and seeking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream with input string, converting it to an integer array and setting initial position and state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stream to its initial state without changing the data.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Advances the stream by one character, updating line and position counters.

methods.name: LA
methods.description: Returns the character at a lookahead position relative to current position.

methods.name: LT
methods.description: Alias for LA, returns the character at lookahead position.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the current position index in the stream.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the input data.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks the current position in the stream for potential backtracking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to a previously marked position.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the current position to a specified index, consuming characters if necessary.

methods.name: substring
methods.description: Returns a substring of the input data between start and stop indices.

methods.name: getCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Returns the current character position in the line.

methods.name: setCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Sets the character position in the current line.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the source stream.
